security_spec.violation_condition: FreeBSD kernel (S-mode) writes spmpcfg[i] with SHARED=1 and U=0, which is now explicitly reserved; hardware behavior is undefined and may silently grant unintended access permissions to U-mode, or kernel relies on M-mode miselect to override L-bit-locked SPMP entries after warm reset but spec no longer guarantees this capability
security_spec.summary: SPMP lock semantics weakened (M-mode miselect override removed) and SHARED=1/U=0 reserved encoding could cause privilege escalation if FreeBSD programs it expecting shared-region behavior
